description: Wieszczka, a pagan seeress of the old Slavic gods, a gaunt woman in a long white linen robe with red embroidery, long loose grey hair with a wreath of dried herbs, blind milky eyes, holding a clay bowl of burning fire in both hands, visions of smoke rising from it, eerie and menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the whole figure inside the picture
